note: Guide pins by Full Clear. Positions are placed on Rockstar's official Leonida map from the sources listed; 'verified' becomes true once a community member confirms in game (Discord /submit).

pins.description: Military base in the southwest Leonida Keys, next to Southwind (official map squares L-2/L-3). Tanks and fighter jets are parked here.
pins.how: Expect a heavy police and army response the moment you trespass.

pins.description: Big airport west of Vice City (official map square H-5). Players report airliners like the 747 on the apron.
pins.how: Planes can be taken, but getting airborne without a wanted level is another story.

pins.description: A helipad on the water in the Leonida Keys, near Key Lento, with a helicopter you can take early.
pins.how: Walk onto the pad and get in. Exact spot not confirmed yet: help us pin it!

pins.location: Seaplanes at Southwind (Sherwin Boatworks / Chicki's Tiki Bar)
pins.description: A hangar on the water side of the boatworks and tiki bar lot in Southwind, next to Mile Zero. Seaplanes sit in or near the hangar and at the dock.
pins.how: Drive southwest from Key Lento on Route 1A, turn into the lot and take a seaplane. Nobody guards them.

pins.description: Gun shop in Southwind, the closest weapons store to the start of the game.
pins.how: Buy weapons and ammo here before heading north.

pins.description: An odd signpost hidden in a clump of trees on the sandy north side of the largest Permit Keys island.
pins.how: Photograph it with the phone camera (WAiNK) for the curiosities collection.

pins.description: The first safehouse. Home gym on the back deck, heavy bag in the shed below, cash stash under the bedroom floor.
pins.how: Train strength, stash cash and use the free house repairs. Exact spot approximate: confirm it on Discord!

pins.description: Roadside store with a big whale sculpture next to the highway in Key Lento; the sculpture stands just south of the store.
pins.how: Scan the sculpture with WAiNK. Pre-order owners collect the Vice City merch bonus here.

pins.description: Two wrecks lie on the sea floor off Key Lento's southeast coast, near a cluster of green islets. More wrecks are south and east of Key Lento.
pins.how: Dive with scuba gear and a metal detector, dig up artefacts and sell them to Kenton.

pins.description: The race track north of Ambrosia hosts repeatable demolition derbies. The figure-eight pays roughly double the oval.
pins.how: Rent a car at the track and win derbies for steady early cash.

pins.description: Shooting range in Manifest Canyon, just south of Father Scrumpy's apple orchard.
pins.how: Go for gold medals: they count toward 100%. The orchard next door is a WAiNK landmark.

pins.description: A statue of the cartoon character from earlier GTA games, to the right of the main entrance of the Y Hotel.
pins.how: Snap it with WAiNK for the sculptures collection.

pins.location: Dock Ring Ferris wheel (Downtown Vice City)
pins.description: Big waterfront Ferris wheel off Catalan Blvd in Downtown Vice City. Position approximate.
pins.how: Scan it with WAiNK for the landmarks collection.

pins.description: Lighthouse on the southern tip of Belpoint island, next to its small settlement, west of Capri.
pins.how: Scan it with WAiNK for the landmarks collection; good sunset photo spot.

pins.description: Across the bay from Jason's first house, at the end of a dead-end road on a mangrove peninsula. Easiest by boat from his dock.
pins.how: Use Focus Mode to follow the noises into the mangroves, then check the effigy on the tree. Exact spot approximate: confirm on Discord!

pins.description: Old paper mill in Moreau, just north of the West Kalaga 247 gas station, next to Adler Creek.
pins.how: Scan it with WAiNK for the landmarks collection.

pins.description: Meditation mat south of MacAlister Gold Mine, across from the paper mill.
pins.how: Sit on the mat and do the breathing minigame (counts toward the meditation trophy).

pins.description: End of the pier next to the tall lookout tower in the middle of Buckskin Swamp.
pins.how: Walk to the mat at the end of the pier and meditate.

pins.description: Stone pattern on the northernmost sandbar of Belpoint, west of Capri.
pins.how: Find the stone pattern on the sand and meditate there.

pins.description: Periscope structure in Downtown Vice City near Catalan Blvd, close to the Dock Ring. Position approximate.
pins.how: Scan it with WAiNK.

pins.description: Giant udder sign at Howe Dairy, a little south of County Road 62 near Emerald Springs.
pins.how: Scan the sign with WAiNK.

pins.description: Orange-themed water tower in the farmland at Tucker's Citrus Farms.
pins.how: Scan the tower with WAiNK.

pins.description: Building in Grayson, directly south of Ledford Motorcycle Workshop on SR-45.
pins.how: Scan it with WAiNK for the landmarks collection.

pins.description: Tower on Sunset Dr in Key Lento, across from Donny's trailer. Position approximate.
pins.how: Climb to the top for the view and scan the tower.

pins.location: Locked van: Bravado Tropic Dawn Youga (Key Lento)
pins.description: Inside the New Wave Custom & Repairs warehouse where Dolphin Dr meets Sunbelt Hwy. Position approximate.
pins.how: Needs the Snap Gun (Chapter 3) to open the warehouse, then take the van.

pins.description: Level 7 of the car park at the Crosstown Police Station, NW 9th St.
pins.how: Slip through the gate after a police car leaves. One of the cars on Randy's wish list.

pins.description: Luxury villa on Flamingo Pkwy in Waning Sands, in the garage nearest the house.
pins.how: Sneak into the garage and drive it out (Randy's wish list).

pins.description: Parked outside the Sweetbay Inn on East Buckley Dr in Capri.
pins.how: Come back around 3 AM in-game, when it's there (Randy's wish list).

pins.description: At the back of the M7 junkyard east of Boone Speedway, off Galerina St in Hamlet.
pins.how: Find it at the rear of the yard and take it (Randy's wish list).

pins.location: Green 'Fast & Furious' sports car garage (Vice City, approximate)
pins.description: A double garage in central Vice City holds the green sports car with the 'I got you' style plate. Breaking in sets off an alarm, but it stops on its own.
pins.how: Only worth taking once you've met Moses (Chapter 2): register it with him (about $6,500+) or it's gone after a reload. Exact spot approximate: confirm on Discord!

pins.location: Raided warehouse full of loot (Hamlet, approximate)
pins.description: A warehouse on the eastern edge of Hamlet where everyone is already down when you arrive: bags of cash, a safe with a collectible card, weapons, vans to load. No fighting needed.
pins.how: Bring a car with a trunk to store the bags, loot every room and body, crack the safe. DPJ made well over $10k early. Exact spot approximate: confirm on Discord!

pins.location: Tiger camp + legendary sniper (Pelican Valley, approximate)
pins.description: A run-down camp east of Pelican Valley, near a small airstrip: a tiger attacks the people there. Afterwards you can loot cash (a few thousand) and a unique sniper rifle.
pins.how: Let the fight end, watch for men arriving by car, grab the sniper and store it in your own car's trunk (register the car) so you don't lose it. Police may show up: leave fast. Approximate spot.

pins.description: Sculpture on Catalan Blvd, a little southeast of the Blanc & Giroux jewellery store. Position approximate.
pins.how: Scan it with WAiNK (sculptures collection).

pins.description: Plaque at the southwest tip of Key Lento, just off the Sunbelt Hwy, west of the Barnacle Beauties salon.
pins.how: Scan it with WAiNK.

pins.description: A giant fishing lure in the park on Thompson Ave, straight south of Lucciano's restaurant.
pins.how: Scan it with WAiNK.

pins.description: Under the southern bridge to Flamingo Island, on Dominoe St.
pins.how: Walk under the bridge and scan the sea god.

pins.location: Smiley stack at the Vice Museum of Art
pins.description: A tower of smiley faces outside the museum in southern Washington Beach, visible from Atlantic Ave.
pins.how: Scan the artwork with WAiNK.

pins.description: Pixel-art fountain on Catalan Blvd, just west of the Tequesta Retreat. Position approximate.
pins.how: Scan it with WAiNK.

pins.description: In northern Manifest Canyon, a short way west of SR-73, north of Port Gellhorn.
pins.how: Leave the highway and scan the monument.

pins.description: A house on Sunset Dr covered in Christmas lights, whatever the season.
pins.how: Scan it with WAiNK (curiosities).

pins.location: Plunge Masters dive shop mural (Key Lento)
pins.description: Mural on the back wall of the Plunge Masters dive centre, Sunset Dr.
pins.how: Walk behind the shop and scan it.

pins.description: Orchard in Kelly County, north of the Rodgers Ranch shooting range.
pins.how: Scan the main building with WAiNK (landmarks).

pins.description: Manifest Canyon, near where the railway crosses the highway.
pins.how: Find the mat and candles; meditate with both Jason and Lucia (each counts).

pins.description: Gator-themed mini golf course at Buckskin Swamp.
pins.how: Play a round: mini golf counts toward 100%.

pins.location: Derelict spy boat + silenced pistol (Permit Keys)
pins.description: A wrecked boat on the southern shore of the easternmost Permit Keys island. Also a WAiNK curiosity.
pins.how: Climb onto the wreck and open the hatch in the middle: free suppressed pistol (Assassin Nipper .38).

pins.location: UFO encounter: 'The Truth Is Out There' trophy (approximate)
pins.description: A roadside car with its alarm and lights going, north-west of the Starlet Motel on the Port Gellhorn side, with a trail into the woods toward a blue glow.
pins.how: After Chapter 1, come at night after 2 AM and follow the blue light. Approximate spot: confirm on Discord!

pins.description: Parked outside The Banana Hole bar on Shore Dr, Ocean Beach.
pins.how: Show up around 6 PM, clone the key, outrun the tracker to Randy.

pins.description: Outside Pegassi Residences on Bayside Dr (Tequesta Retreat).
pins.how: Around 6:30 PM: slip past the guards, clone the key, drive it to Randy's lockup.

pins.location: Karin Futo in the postal depot (Draper Island)
pins.description: Big postal building on the southern tip of Draper Island.
pins.how: Enter by the north-west door near the railway, start the car before raising the shutters, escape to Moses.

pins.location: Western Nightblade at the biker clubhouse (Ambrosia)
pins.description: Motorcycle club compound on Birch St, Ambrosia.
pins.how: Go in over the roof, open the gate first, distract the guards and hotwire the bike for Moses.

pins.location: Declasse Vamos in a locked garage (east of Grayson)
pins.description: A house on Rockledge Rd, east of Grayson.
pins.how: Find the garage code inside the main house, then survive the chase back to Moses.

pins.description: Dirt trails in the north-east of Buckskin Swamp.
pins.how: Chase the buggy on a dirt bike, tag it with WAiNK and take it. All 7 Moses drop-offs earn his Emperor Sultan.

pins.description: Dinosaur-themed mini golf in Frogswater.
pins.how: Play a round: 2 of the 3 mini golf courses count toward 100%.

pins.description: Western-themed mini golf in Waning Sands.
pins.how: Play a round for the mini golf checklist.

pins.location: Exotic Animals Front, behind Three Sheets Liquor (Key Lento, approximate)
pins.description: A guarded walled yard where birds are smuggled. One of the parrots in a cage gives you a hint about hidden cash.
pins.how: Climb the fence, deal with or sneak past the guards, talk to the parrot, then look in the vent beside the generator for roughly $1.2k.

pins.description: A wrestling ring in someone's backyard. Your opponent goes by Gentrifier.
pins.how: Knock on the trailer door twice to start the fight. Win it and you can loot the trailer (Luchador Mask and cash), then look on the bleachers for a collectible card.
pins.source: Shacknews (house shown on their map only)

pins.location: The Vault nightclub, between Crosstown and Downtown (approximate)
pins.description: Scanning a poster inside this club unlocks a hidden EDM radio station.
pins.how: Head up the stairs inside. Next to the ATM is a poster of a gas mask covered in flowers: scan it with WAiNK.

pins.location: Chuck's Tackle & Shot (Key Lento, near Jason's house, approximate)
pins.description: This gun and tackle shop sells neckwear masks, which make it harder for police to recognise you.
pins.how: Go in, then right and left. Masks are on the Neckwear shelf. Once bought, pick Wear Style 1 so the mask covers your face.

pins.location: Thicc Herbie blimp, moored on Maroon Key
pins.description: An advertising blimp tied down on a small island.
pins.how: Scan it with WAiNK. Push Square says the best angle is from the viewpoint at the north-west end of Abismo Key.

pins.location: One-off cars to scan in Key Lento (approximate)
pins.description: Key Lento has a few unusual parked cars you can scan with WAiNK and then take.
pins.how: Nagasaki Rudolph Tao: by the Christmas-lit corner of Sunset Dr and Laguna Dr. Vapid Shifter: outside Shrimp & Save. Declasse Akane: outside Cousin Carlo's.

pins.description: A deep dive with no wreck, but 5 of Kenton's Treasures lie on the bottom and they sell well.
pins.how: Dive just off Belpoint's southern tip, on the Bobcat Bight side. These treasures don't count as Underwater Discoveries.

pins.description: Partygoers hang out around a wooden hut on one of the Permit Keys.
pins.how: Find the island with the big green area at the top of the group, then scan the hut that has the orange Fizzazz sign.
